brique._comment: Engine-native Reflexive family capacity. kind/wrapper/rel_ctx/lang do not apply here.

objective.name: read.meaning
objective.description: Read meaning descriptors for one or more local Brique elements.

#root.role: Resolve one or more local element descriptors, filter the requested sections, and return one result entry per requested item.

input._comment: Required non-empty array of meaning read requests. Each item: { element_kind (string — accepted values: context, capacity, schema, document; matter and structure are refused by Reflexive), element_name (string — name of the element within the addressed context; for context, name is ignored), sections (optional string array: brique|objective|functional|subjective — brique always included), include_resolution (optional bool, default false — when false, strips functional.#root.resolution for capacity items), detail (optional string, default 'invoke' — for capacity items only: 'invoke' reduces functional.#root to {role, inputs, outputs}, taking precedence over include_resolution since resolution is dropped either way; pass 'full' for the entire descriptor) }.

result._comment: Per-item result list. Each item on success: { ok: true, element_kind (string), element_name (string), path (string — navigation path within context), descriptor (object — filtered descriptor JSON) }. On failure: { ok: false, element_kind, element_name, path, error: { code, message } }.

effects.meaning_descriptors: Meaning descriptor files under the current context may be read.

transformation_contract.morphing: A list of local Brique element references becomes a per-item meaning result set carrying either the requested meaning sections or an explicit item-level error.
invariants: Each input item is handled independently and contributes one result entry.
brique is always included in the returned descriptor sections even when callers request narrower sections.
Matter and structure descriptors are refused by Reflexive because they are owned by MatterLoop.
When element_kind is capacity and functional is in the requested sections, functional.#root.resolution is stripped unless include_resolution is explicitly true.
When element_kind is capacity, functional.#root is reduced to {role, inputs, outputs} unless detail is explicitly 'full', regardless of include_resolution.
success: On success, the capacity returns result entries with ok=true, element identity fields, a navigation path, and descriptor containing the filtered descriptor sections in source key order.
Per-item resolution failures remain encoded inside result entries instead of failing the whole call once params.input is valid.
failure: The capacity fails when params.input is missing or is not a non-empty array.
Individual items return ok=false entries when the element cannot be resolved, escapes scope, is invalid JSON, or is unsupported.
notes: read.meaning targets local element descriptors under the current context only.
descriptor remains an ordinary JSON object on the wire while preserving source key order.
Item-level errors are part of the normal payload contract for mixed or partially invalid request sets.
